title: Astro Bot
listNote: This is the PS5 list, the only one. It has 44 base trophies plus 19 in four groups added by free updates: Stellar Speedway (6), Winter Wonder (3), Vicious Void (5) and Vicious Void 2 (5). None of the update trophies are needed for the Platinum.
summary: Rebuild the PS5 mothership and rescue 300 bots across five galaxies. No missables and no difficulty settings: a collectathon finished off by the Great Master Challenge, a tough platforming gauntlet.
intro: Space Bully Nebulax has ripped the CPU out of Astro's PS5-shaped mothership and scattered the crew. Astro crash-lands at Crash Site and heads out across five galaxies to recover the ship's parts and rescue 300 bots, many of them dressed as PlayStation and other game characters.

There are no missable trophies, no difficulty settings and no online trophies. PSTHC puts the Platinum at about 9 hours and 4/10; PowerPyx says about 15 hours and 3/10. Most of the work is finding every bot and puzzle piece, saving up about 15,000 coins for the Gatcha Lab, and setting up a few jokes between the cameo bots in Crash Site.

The hardest trophy is [[the-golden-bot]]: once you have every bot and puzzle piece, the Great Master Challenge is a three-minute platforming course where any death sends you back to the start. The four free update groups add speedruns, a festive level and ten very hard challenge levels.

playthroughs.note: Levels can be replayed from the galaxy map after the story, so nothing is missable. Replays also farm coins for the Gatcha Lab.

dlc.title: Stellar Speedway
dlc.note: Free update (October–November 2024): five speedrun levels in a yellow galaxy that appears after you finish the main game. Not needed for the Platinum.

dlc.title: Winter Wonder
dlc.note: Free update (December 2024): one festive level. Not needed for the Platinum.

dlc.title: Vicious Void
dlc.note: Free update (February–March 2025): five challenge levels in the Vicious Void Galaxy, open once you've finished the main game. Each ends with a Special Bot, and rescuing it unlocks Time Attack for that level. Not needed for the Platinum.

dlc.title: Vicious Void 2
dlc.note: Free update (July 2025): five more Vicious Void challenge levels, ending with Megamix Mastery. Not needed for the Platinum.

route.title: Gorilla Nebula
route.summary: The first galaxy. Collect every bot and puzzle piece as you go: the Crash Site rooms open as your puzzle piece total grows.
steps: Sky Garden gives you [[one-bot-down]] and [[a-puzzling-start]] straight away.
In Construction Derby, dunk a basketball for [[um-jammer-slammy]]. In Apes On The Loose, catch the gold butterfly with the net for [[net-profit]].
On the galaxy map, destroy the ring of asteroids to open the Retro Rampage 1 level and rescue Ryu, who you need for [[ko]] later.
Rescue every bot in the galaxy for [[monkey-see-monkey-rescue]]. Finishing the galaxy gives [[unforgettable]].
With 16 puzzle pieces, return to Crash Site to open the Gatcha Lab ([[licence-to-spend]]) and spend 100 coins for [[first-prize]].

route.title: Tentacle System
route.summary: Three level-specific tricks, plus several cameo bots you'll need for the Crash Site trophies.
steps: In Trunk of Funk, spray Papa Tree's face while he sings for [[what-is-he-saying]].
In Bot of War, find and defeat all eight ravens for [[eyes-of-the-all-father]].
In Wormy Passage, grab two Wormys at once with the frog gloves for [[double-dug-in]].

Rescue every bot for [[tentacular-spectacular]], including Kratos (Wako Tako), Thor (Bot of War), the Prince (Downsize Surprise) and Ken (Retro Rampage 2, opened by an asteroid group on this galaxy's map). Finishing the galaxy gives [[solid-performance]].
With 32 puzzle pieces, return to Crash Site for [[splash-my-dash]].

route.title: Serpent Starway
route.summary: A casino and a tomb raid.
steps: In Slo-Mo Casino, slow time and hit the jackpot on all four slot machines for [[time-to-cash-in]].
In Dude Raiding, find all three egg artefacts for [[the-lost-eggacy]].
Rescue every bot for [[fangs-very-much]], including Nathan Drake at the end of the galaxy. Finishing it gives [[doing-it-for-you]].
With 48 puzzle pieces, return to Crash Site for [[time-for-a-change]].

route.title: Camo Cosmos
route.summary: Dolphins, a pyramid, and the camera.
steps: In Bubbling Under, leap through the ring with the dolphins for [[jumping-through-hoops]].

Rescue Lara Croft, hidden underground in Hieroglitch Pyramid, and Kazuma Kiryu from Boing! Bonanza (a hidden square level on this galaxy's map). Every bot gives [[nowhere-to-hide]], and finishing the galaxy gives [[keep-it-cool]].
With 64 puzzle pieces, return to Crash Site to open the Safari Park ([[animal-attraction]]), which gives you the camera. Take a photo at a glowing photo spot for [[strike-a-pose]].

route.title: Feather Cluster and the final boss
route.summary: The last galaxy and the end of the story. The world stays open afterwards.
steps: In Machine Learning, lure seven enemies into the Tripcaster's wires in one life for [[what-a-trip]].
Rescue every bot for [[back-to-the-nest]]. Finishing the galaxy gives [[take-cover]].
Beat the final boss to save the CPU Kid for [[a-lot-to-process]].

route.title: Lost Galaxy
route.summary: Ten secret levels hidden in the main galaxies' levels, plus Final Encore once they're all done. You need them for the last bots and puzzle pieces.
steps: Find the two hidden exits in each main galaxy that lead to the Lost Galaxy (see [[lost-and-found]] for every one).
Clear all ten secret levels, then Final Encore, and rescue every bot for [[lost-and-found]].
Mop up any remaining bots and puzzle pieces. With all 120 pieces, return to Crash Site for [[monumental-achievement]].

route.title: Gatcha Lab and Crash Site jokes
route.summary: Spend your coins, then set up the cameo bots' gags. Several need a specific Gatcha prize, so do the Gatcha Lab first.
steps: Win 150 Gatcha prizes for [[money-well-spent]]. That's about 15,000 coins; replay levels to farm more.
Climb the ladder beside the rebuilt ship and watch the parts sing for [[singstars]], then climb the scaffolding to the top for [[at-the-top-of-my-game]].
Call 100 bots and dance with them for [[bot-bot-revolution]]. Break a bot wall for [[wall-buster]], and knock a bot out of a tower without it falling for [[keep-it-together]].

Cameo jokes: photograph Nathan Drake and Lara Croft together ([[thick-as-thieves]]), get Thor frozen by Kratos's axe ([[thaw-god-of-thunder]]), get rolled up by the Prince ([[royally-stuck]]), dance with Crash ([[lets-twist-again]]), make Kiryu drop his items ([[deep-pocket-dragon]]), and get hit by both Ryu and Ken ([[ko]]).

route.title: The Great Master Challenge
route.summary: The hardest trophy in the base game. You need every bot to reach it.
steps: With all 120 puzzle pieces and 300 bots, use the bots to build a wall up the Golden Statue in Crash Site.
Play the Great Master Challenge at the top. It's about three minutes long, and any death sends you back to the start.
Finish it to rescue the Special Master Bot for [[the-golden-bot]].

route.title: Platinum
route.summary: Unlocks once the other 43 base-game trophies are earned. The update trophies aren't required.
steps: Compare your trophy list with the checklist here, and replay any level with something missing.

route.title: Five speedrun levels
route.summary: Each level hides two bots behind a time limit, shown by a blue bird and a red bird. About 30 to 60 minutes in all.
steps: Find the yellow Stellar Speedway galaxy on the space map, between the green and red galaxies (top right).

In each level, beat the blue bird to the finish for one bot, or the red bird for both. Any rescue earns that level's trophy: [[hurtle-rescue]], [[ice-cold-rescue]], [[punchy-rescue]], [[breezy-rescue]] and [[flaming-rescue]].
Beat the red bird in all five for [[fast-and-found]].

route.title: The festive level
route.summary: One level with a costume, 15 presents and a tree to climb.
steps: On the space map, fly into the meteorite wearing a red Santa hat (top left). The level then appears on the far right.
Hit the large golden present on the left at the start for [[astro-ho-ho]].
Open all 15 golden presents for [[unwrapped]]; they also hold the level's 7 bots.
Climb to the top of the festive tree for [[youre-a-star]].

route.title: First five challenge levels
route.summary: Much harder than the main game, built to test your platforming. Each level ends with a Special Bot.
steps: Finish the main game, then enter the Vicious Void Galaxy on the space map.
Clear each level to rescue its Special Bot: [[timely-rescue]], [[thrusting-rescue]], [[rooster-rescue]], [[bearly-rescued]] and [[rolling-rescue]].

route.title: Five more challenge levels
route.summary: The July 2025 levels, ending with Megamix Mastery, the hardest level in the game.
steps: In the Vicious Void Galaxy, clear each new level to rescue its Special Bot: [[springy-rescue]], [[slimy-rescue]], [[hanging-rescue]] and [[pumping-rescue]].
Finish Megamix Mastery for [[impossible-rescue]].

trophies.name: One Bot Down…

trophies.unlock: Rescue any bot.
steps: Start Sky Garden. The first bot is right at the start.

Break the crates near the basketball court to free the ball.
Hit the ball into the net.

trophies.where: Gorilla Nebula: Apes On The Loose

A golden butterfly flies out and circles. Jump and swing the net to catch it.

trophies.unlock: Rescue every bot in Gorilla Nebula, including the ones in its asteroid-unlocked levels.

Destroy the ring of asteroids on the galaxy map to open Retro Rampage 1 (with Ryu).
Replay any level from the galaxy map to find missing bots.

steps: Spend 100 coins on the Gatcha Lab claw machine.

trophies.name: What Is He Saying?
trophies.description: Splashed Papa Tree's face during his song.
trophies.unlock: Spray Papa Tree's face with water while he's singing.
steps: Water the seed early in Trunk of Funk.
When the tree grows and starts singing, spray his face with the water cannon.

trophies.name: Eyes Of The All-Father
trophies.description: Found and defeated all eight ravens in Bot Of War.
trophies.unlock: Find and defeat all eight ravens hidden in the level.
steps: Look around every area of Bot of War for ravens, including off the main path.
Defeat each one. If you miss any, replay the level; a video of all eight helps.

trophies.name: Double Dug-in
trophies.description: Took out two Wormys at the same time.
trophies.unlock: Defeat two Wormys at once.
steps: Use the Froggy Gloves to grab two Wormys at the same time. The level gives several chances.

trophies.name: Tentacular Spectacular
trophies.description: Rescued all Bots in Tentacle System
trophies.unlock: Rescue every bot in Tentacle System, including its asteroid-unlocked level.
steps: Search every level for bots.
Destroy the asteroid group near the top of the galaxy map to open Retro Rampage 2 (with Ken).
Replay any level from the galaxy map to find missing bots.

trophies.name: Solid Performance
trophies.description: Recovered the Mothership's SSD.
trophies.unlock: Story-related: finish Tentacle System.
steps: Clear Tentacle System's levels and boss. The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Splash My Dash
trophies.description: Opened the Dual Speeder Garage.
trophies.unlock: Collect 32 puzzle pieces, then return to Crash Site.
steps: With 32 puzzle pieces, go back to Crash Site.

trophies.name: Time To Cash In!
trophies.description: Stopped time and won the jackpot on all four slot machines in Slo-Mo Casino.
trophies.when: Near the start of the level
trophies.unlock: Hit the jackpot (three yellow bot icons) on all four slot machines, using the time-slowing power-up.
steps: Get the Slo-Mo power-up near the start.
Slow time at each of the four slot machines and stop them on three yellow bot icons.
Retry as many times as you need.

trophies.name: The Lost Eggacy
trophies.description: Collected all three egg artefacts in Dude Raiding.
trophies.unlock: Find all three eggs.
steps: Near the stuck plane, rotate the four wall stones to the double-dash icon.
Jump the platforms after the slide.
In the purple cave, climb halfway up the rope and jump off to reach the last egg.

trophies.name: Fangs Very Much!
trophies.description: Rescued all Bots in Serpent Starway.
trophies.unlock: Rescue every bot in Serpent Starway.
steps: Search every level for bots. Nathan Drake is at the end of the galaxy.
Replay any level from the galaxy map to find missing bots.

trophies.name: Doing It For You
trophies.description: Recovered the Mothership's GPU.
trophies.unlock: Story-related: finish Serpent Starway.
steps: Clear Serpent Starway's levels and boss. The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Time For A Change
trophies.description: Opened the Changing Room.
trophies.unlock: Collect 48 puzzle pieces, then return to Crash Site.
steps: With 48 puzzle pieces, go back to Crash Site.

trophies.name: Jumping Through Hoops
trophies.description: Leapt through the ring in Bubbling Under.
trophies.unlock: Leap through the ring near the dolphins.
steps: After freeing the starfish, swim up to the surface, where dolphins play near a ring in the air.
With the penguin power-up, leap out of the water through the ring.

trophies.name: Nowhere To Hide
trophies.description: Rescued all Bots in Camo Cosmos.
trophies.unlock: Rescue every bot in Camo Cosmos, including the hidden square level Boing! Bonanza.
steps: Search every level for bots.
Lara Croft is hidden underground in Hieroglitch Pyramid: destroy the vases behind the third crushing block, drill down (charged **Square**), then walk slowly under the traps.
On the galaxy map, fly into the bottom-left asteroid and circle until the pink square button appears, to open Boing! Bonanza (with Kazuma Kiryu).
Replay any level from the galaxy map to find missing bots.

trophies.name: Keep It Cool
trophies.description: Recovered the Mothership's Cooling Fan.
trophies.unlock: Story-related: finish Camo Cosmos.
steps: Clear Camo Cosmos's levels and boss. The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Animal Attraction
trophies.description: Opened the Safari Park.
trophies.unlock: Collect 64 puzzle pieces, then return to Crash Site. The Safari Park gives you the camera.
steps: With 64 puzzle pieces, go back to Crash Site.

trophies.name: Strike A Pose!
trophies.description: Took a picture at a Photo Spot.
trophies.unlock: Take a photo at a photo spot.
steps: Open the Safari Park (64 puzzle pieces) to get the camera.
Stand on a blue-glowing photo spot inside it, press **Up** for the camera and **R2** to take the photo.

trophies.name: What A Trip!
trophies.description: Defeated seven enemies with the Tripcaster.
trophies.unlock: Defeat seven enemies with the Tripcaster's wires within one life.
steps: Get the Tripcaster power-up in Machine Learning.
Lure enemies across the purple tripwires until seven are defeated, without dying.
mistakes: Using the feet lasers, which break the wires.
Wasting wires on electric enemies, which are immune.

trophies.name: Back To The Nest
trophies.description: Rescued all Bots in Feather Cluster.
trophies.unlock: Rescue every bot in Feather Cluster.
steps: Search every level for bots.
Replay any level from the galaxy map to find missing bots.

trophies.name: Take Cover!
trophies.description: Recovered the Mothership's Protection Covers.
trophies.unlock: Story-related: finish Feather Cluster.
steps: Clear Feather Cluster's levels and boss. The trophy unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: A Lot To Process
trophies.description: Saved the CPU Kid.
trophies.unlock: Story-related: beat all five galaxies and the final boss.
steps: Finish the five galaxies, then beat the final boss.

trophies.name: Lost And Found
trophies.description: Rescued all Bots in Lost Galaxy.
trophies.where: Lost Galaxy (10 secret levels plus Final Encore)
trophies.unlock: Rescue every bot in the Lost Galaxy. Its ten levels are reached through hidden exits, two in each main galaxy; Final Encore appears in the middle once all ten are done.
steps: **Fan Club**: in Az-Tech Trail, put out the four wall fires in a small temple.
**Funky Fungi**: in Creamy Canyon, throw a pig at the frozen seal sculpture, then drill into the sand.
**Light Bulb Limbo**: in Go-Go Archipelago, after the boss, spin down through the gap where a pincer landed.
**Boxel Bust-Up**: in Downsize Surprise, use the blue floor plate and the bubble-blowing frog, then ride the bubble to a tree branch.
**Furnace Fever**: in Bathhouse Battle, fill a pool, grow sponges into platforms, put out the chimney fire and jump in.
**Ghouls & Bots**: in Free Big Brother, after freeing the big robot, stand on the two lightning platforms during the alien's attacks.
**Rocket Pull Power!**: in Hieroglitch Pyramid, break the wooden boards behind the normal exit as a metal ball to get launched up.
**Danger Dojo**: in Balloon Breeze, reach the pot in the sky, slash the bamboo and use the thrusters on the metal ring around the eyes.
**High-Suction Hero**: in Djinny of the Lamp, after beating the Djinny, climb the invisible platforms and ride the carpet to the top.
**Turtles In Trash**: in Frozen Meal, push a snowball to a ledge, pull the wire and suck out the ice blocks.
**Final Encore**: appears in the middle of the Lost Galaxy once the other ten are done.

trophies.name: Monumental Achievement
trophies.description: Unlocked the Golden Statue.
trophies.unlock: Collect all 120 puzzle pieces, then return to Crash Site.
steps: With every puzzle piece, go back to Crash Site. The Golden Statue appears.

trophies.name: Money Well Spent
trophies.description: Earned 150 prizes from the Gatcha Lab.
trophies.unlock: Win 150 prizes. Each play costs 100 coins, so you need at least 15,000. There are 169 prizes, and the machine sometimes drops an empty soda can, which can cost you extra plays.
steps: Collect coins as you play; big coins hidden in trees and flowers are worth more.
Replay levels to farm more. PowerPyx recommends Danger Dojo in the Lost Galaxy and the +100 chest at the end of levels.
Spend everything at the Gatcha Lab until you have 150 prizes.
tips: PSTHC notes that coins respawn after a death, so replaying a coin-heavy stretch from a checkpoint works too.

trophies.name: SingStars
trophies.description: Witnessed all ship parts singing together in Crash Site.
trophies.where: Crash Site, beside the PS5 ship
trophies.unlock: With every ship part recovered, watch them sing together.
steps: Finish the story so the ship is complete.
Climb the ladder on the side of the PS5 ship to its platform. The cover opens.
Stand there for a few seconds while the parts sing.

trophies.name: At The Top Of My Game
trophies.description: Made it to the top of the Mothership.
trophies.unlock: Climb to the top of the rebuilt Mothership.
steps: Beat all five galaxies so the Mothership is assembled in the middle of Crash Site.
Climb the scaffolding on its right side to the top.

trophies.name: Bot Bot Revolution
trophies.description: Danced with 100 Bots in Crash Site.
trophies.unlock: Dance with at least 100 bots around you.
steps: Rescue more than 100 bots.
In Crash Site, whistle with **Triangle** to call them.
When they're close, press **Down** to dance together.

trophies.name: Wall Buster
trophies.description: Broke up a Bot Wall.
trophies.unlock: Knock down a wall of bots.
steps: Call your bots to build a wall or tower somewhere they're needed in Crash Site (PowerPyx uses a 90-bot tower left of the spawn point).
Hit bots at the bottom with **Square** until the wall breaks apart.

trophies.name: Keep It Together!
trophies.description: Knocked a Bot out of a Bot Tower without it collapsing.
trophies.unlock: Hit a bot out of a supporting tower while the rest of it stays up.
steps: Call bots to hold something up. PowerPyx uses the 10 bots lifting stones left of the spawn point.
Hit the bottom bot so it pops out while the tower stays standing.

trophies.name: Thick As Thieves
trophies.description: Captured a photo of two legendary explorers in Crash Site.
trophies.when: With Drake, Lara and the camera
prerequisites: Lara Croft (hidden underground in Hieroglitch Pyramid, Camo Cosmos).
trophies.unlock: Take a photo with Nathan Drake and Lara Croft both in the frame.
steps: Call your bots with **Triangle**.
Press **Up** for the camera and keep taking photos (**R2**) until both are in the shot.
tips: PSTHC suggests a dinosaur prize from the Gatcha Lab, which makes Lara run past Nathan.
It can take several photos before it registers.

trophies.name: Thaw, God of Thunder!
trophies.description: Froze a hammer-wielding deity with the axe in Crash Site.
trophies.when: With Kratos, Thor and Kratos's prize
prerequisites: Kratos's Well-Stocked Campfire prize from the Gatcha Lab.
trophies.unlock: Get Thor frozen by Kratos's axe.
steps: Slap Kratos so he throws his axe at you.
Take cover behind Thor so the axe freezes him instead.

trophies.name: Royally Stuck
trophies.description: Got a little too close to a sticky sphere in Crash Site.
trophies.when: With the Prince and his prize
prerequisites: His Rolling Star prize from the Gatcha Lab.
trophies.unlock: Get rolled up by the Prince's ball.
steps: Find the Prince on the left side of Crash Site.
Slap him so he rolls his ball over you.

trophies.name: Let's Twist Again
trophies.description: Busted a move with an iconic marsupial in Crash Site.
prerequisites: His Protective Spirit prize from the Gatcha Lab.
trophies.unlock: Dance with Crash Bandicoot.
steps: Wait for Crash to start dancing.
Get close and press **Down** to dance with him.

trophies.name: Deep-Pocket Dragon
trophies.description: Made a tough guy drop all his items in Crash Site.
prerequisites: Kazuma Kiryu (reward for Boing! Bonanza, a hidden square level in Camo Cosmos).
His Iconic Gate prize from the Gatcha Lab.
trophies.unlock: Hit Kiryu until he drops everything he's carrying.
steps: Find Kiryu on the right side of Crash Site.
Slap him repeatedly until all his items fall out.

trophies.name: KO!
trophies.description: Picked a fight with two street fighting warriors in Crash Site.
prerequisites: Ryu (Retro Rampage 1: destroy the ring of asteroids on Gorilla Nebula's map).
Ken (Retro Rampage 2: destroy the asteroid group near the top of Tentacle System's map).
trophies.unlock: Get hit by both Ryu and Ken.
steps: Find Ryu and Ken at the back right of Crash Site.
Hit each of them, then stand between them so they both answer with their special moves.

trophies.name: The Golden Bot
trophies.description: Rescued the Special Master Bot at the top of the Golden Statue.
prerequisites: All 120 puzzle pieces (to unlock the statue).
All 300 bots (to build the wall up it).
trophies.unlock: Reach the top of the Golden Statue and finish the Great Master Challenge.
steps: Collect every puzzle piece so the Golden Statue appears ([[monumental-achievement]]).
Call all 300 bots to form a wall up the statue, and climb it.
Play the Great Master Challenge. It lasts about three minutes, with no pause, and any death sends you back to the start.
Finish it to rescue the Special Master Bot.
tips: Learn the course section by section. Each attempt teaches you the next part.

trophies.name: Astro-nomical!
trophies.description: Earned all Trophies. Well done and see you in Astro's next adventure!
trophies.unlock: Earn the other 43 base-game trophies. The update trophies aren't needed.
steps: Compare your trophy list with the checklist here and finish anything missing.

trophies.description: Rescued a Bot in Building Speed.
trophies.unlock: Beat the blue bird to the finish (one bot) or the red bird (two bots).
steps: Learn the route, then finish ahead of the blue bird.

trophies.name: Punchy Rescue

trophies.name: Breezy Rescue

trophies.unlock: Beat the blue bird to the finish (one bot) or the red bird (two bots).

trophies.unlock: Beat the blue bird to the finish (one bot) or the red bird (two bots).

trophies.name: Astro-ho-ho!
trophies.description: Changed into the Festive Fellow Outfit.
trophies.unlock: Put on the Festive Fellow outfit.
steps: Hit the large golden present on the left at the start of the level.

trophies.name: Unwrapped!
trophies.description: Opened all presents in Winter Wonder.
trophies.unlock: Open all 15 golden presents. They also hold the level's 7 bots.
steps: Open every golden present you find.
Replay the level for any you missed; a presents video guide helps.

trophies.name: You're a star!
trophies.description: Climbed to the top of the festive tree in Winter Wonder.
trophies.unlock: Reach the very top of the festive tree.
steps: Open the blue gear chest to the right of the big tree for the monkey drummer power-up.
Use it (**L2+R2**) on the bulbs: the left two, then the right two.
Ride the rails to the igloo roof, spin through the igloo and grab the balloon chest.
Float up to the squid, pump it with **L2** and get catapulted onto the tree's platforms.
Balloon between platforms to the last one, then fly into the blue balloon above the top yellow present to reach the top.

trophies.name: Timely Rescue
trophies.description: Rescued the Bot in Tick-Tock Shock.
trophies.unlock: Reach the end of the level to rescue its Special Bot.
steps: Finish the main game so the Vicious Void Galaxy opens.
Clear Tick-Tock Shock. The Special Bot waits at the goal.
tips: These levels are much harder than the main game; expect plenty of retries.
